# Lab 27.15: Enable Access Transparency & Access Approval

## What We Are Going to Do
Turn on Access Transparency to see Google staff access, and Access Approval to require your approval first.

## Steps

1. **Check the requirement.** Access Transparency is enabled at organization level and needs a qualifying Google Cloud support package. Ask your administrator if you do not see the option.

2. **Enable Access Transparency.** Go to **IAM & Admin → Settings** with the organization selected. Under **Access Transparency**, click **Enable Access Transparency for Organization**.

3. **Know where the logs go.** Access Transparency logs are written to the `_Required` bucket and kept for 400 days. Query them with:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • TEXT
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">logName:"cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Faccess_transparency"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Each entry shows the Google staff role, location, justification and the resource accessed.

4. **Enable Access Approval for a project.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable accessapproval.googleapis.com
gcloud access-approval settings update --project=$PROJECT_ID \
  --enrolled_services=all \
  --notification_emails=YOUR_EMAIL
gcloud access-approval settings get --project=$PROJECT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Grant approvers.** Give **Access Approval Approver** (`roles/accessapproval.approver`) to a small security group.

6. **Handle a request.** When Google support needs access, for example after you open a support case, a request arrives by email.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud access-approval requests list --project=$PROJECT_ID
gcloud access-approval requests approve REQUEST_ID --project=$PROJECT_ID
gcloud access-approval requests dismiss REQUEST_ID --project=$PROJECT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


7. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud access-approval settings delete --project=$PROJECT_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Access Transparency | Logs of Google staff actions |
| Access Approval | Your approval needed before access |
| Dependency | Access Approval relies on Access Transparency |
| Exclusions | Some access types, such as legal requests, are not covered |
